commentary_segments.text: Comparison of the models of MOST and bipolar technologies show that MOSTs are actually modulated resistances, whereas bipolar transistors employ a forward biased diode as an input. A bipolar transistor does not have a threshold voltage V and always has T an exponential I /V rela- CE BE tionship. Its current is a small current I multiplied S by the voltage V , scaled BE by kT/q. This is worked out further next.
